html:
<cs-rubric
  [rubric]="assessment().rubric"
  (selected)="changed.emit({ selection: $event })"
/><textarea
  csTextarea
  [value]="assessment().comment"
  (input)="changed.emit({ comment: $any($event.target).value })"
></textarea
><button csButton="secondary" (click)="decided.emit({ decision: 'return' })">Return</button
><button csButton (click)="decided.emit({ decision: 'approve' })">Approve</button>
